ask: splt the rent by rom so it adds up to 2400 and utils evn plz
sentence: Splits a fixed monthly rent across rooms so the room rents always add up to the total, divides utilities evenly, and shows each person one monthly amount.
use_when: Housemates need to divide a set rent total between rooms of different size or value
Utilities should be shared equally on top of room rent
Someone wants to shift rent dollars from one room to another and keep the total fixed
Everyone wants to see what each person owes per month
dont_use_when: Splitting a one-time bill or dinner check by item
Tracking who paid whom over time or settling running debts
